landing.heroTitle: Rescue Unsold Perishable Harvests Before Spoilage
landing.heroBody: PolamRaksha connects small and marginal farmers with verified wholesale and institutional buyers through deadline-aware auctions, multi-buyer allocation, and automatic cancellation recovery.
landing.problemBody: Smallholder farmers frequently face sudden market gluts or transport gaps where perishable vegetables and fruits spoil within 24–72 hours if unsold.
landing.howStep1Body: Farmers list unsold produce with harvest time and spoilage deadline via smartphone, keypad phone + PIN, or an authorized field operator.
landing.howStep2Body: Buyers bid in real time. Google OR-Tools CP-SAT allocates produce across multiple buyers while factoring in transport cost and deadlines.
landing.howStep3Body: If a buyer cancels before pickup, remaining perishable inventory is automatically re-allocated to backup buyers.
landing.accessibilityBody: Farmers with ordinary keypad phones authenticate via phone number + PIN, and farmers without personal devices are supported by explicitly authorized field operators with full audit logging.
landing.liveListingsEmpty: No active produce listings are currently published.
landing.limitationsBody: PolamRaksha is an early-stage platform. Auction bidding, OR-Tools allocation, and SMS/IVR gateway integrations are rolled out incrementally; internet connectivity or operator assistance is required for live updates.
landing.contactBody: For farmer onboarding, buyer verification, or technical inquiries, reach the PolamRaksha team at support@polamraksha.local.
